title: Waqtiga firaaqada
description: Ten short, simple stories about free time and hobbies in Somali towns and the countryside: a first swim in the river, a football game, a grandmother's garden, a visit to the camels, a young cook, an old shop, a school story exhibition, a family trip to Taleex, an evening with the radio and a girl who takes photos.

lessons.title: Mahad iyo webiga
lessons.summary: Ten-year-old Mahad in Jowhar wants to learn to swim in the Shabeelle; his uncle Barkhad says the river is dangerous in the morning fog, they wait until it lifts, and Mahad swims for the first time.
lessons.text:
Mahad waa inan yar oo ku nool Jowhar. Wuxuu jiraa toban sano. Gurigoodu wuxuu u dhow yahay Webiga Shabeelle. Mahad wuxuu rabaa inuu barto dabaasha, laakiin weli ma uusan dabaalan.

Subax, Mahad goor hore ayuu kacay. Adeerkiis Barkhad ayaa gurigooda joogay. Barkhad si fiican ayuu u dabaashaa.

"Adeer, fadlan i bar dabaasha," ayuu yidhi Mahad. "Fadlan, aynu tagno webiga."

Barkhad wuxuu eegay dibadda. Subaxaas caad badan ayaa jiray, wax fogna lama arki karin.

"Maya, Mahad," ayuu yidhi Barkhad. "Hadda caad ayaa jira. Marka caad jiro, webigu waa hanjabaad. Waynu sugaynaa ilaa caadku tago."

"Fadlan, adeer!" ayuu yidhi Mahad.

"Maya. Webigu hadda waa hanjabaad. Waynu sugaynaa," ayuu yidhi Barkhad.

Mahad wuu sugay. Mar kasta wuu jeestay oo dibadda ayuu eegay. Caadku weli wuu joogay. Saacad kadib caadkii wuu tagay. Cirka iyo webiga si fiican ayaa loo arkay.

"Hadda waynu tagi karnaa," ayuu yidhi Barkhad. Labadoodu waxay tageen webiga. Markay webiga gaadheen, Barkhad wuxuu yidhi: "Webigu weli waa hanjabaad. Meel fog ha u dabaalan. Ila joog."

Barkhad iyo Mahad webiga way galeen. Barkhad wuxuu Mahad baray sida loo dabaasho. Marka hore dabaashu adag bay ahayd, laakiin Mahad ma uusan joojin. Kadib wuu dabaashay! Wuxuu u dabaashay ilaa adeerkiis.

Markaas Mahad wuu jeestay. Wuxuu arkay meesha uu ka bilaabay. Meel fog ma ahayn, laakiin Mahad aad buu u faraxsanaa.

"Adeer, waan dabaashay!" ayuu yidhi Mahad.

"Haa, inanka yar wuu dabaashay," ayuu yidhi Barkhad.

Subaxa dambe Mahad goor hore ayuu kacay. Caad ma jirin. "Adeer, fadlan, aynu tagno webiga!" ayuu yidhi. Barkhad wuu qoslay. "Haa, Mahad. Maanta caad ma jiro. Waynu tagaynaa."

Su'aalo:
Mahad meeshee buu ku nool yahay?
Mahad wuxuu ku nool yahay Jowhar.
Subaxaas maxaa jiray?
Subaxaas caad badan ayaa jiray.
Barkhad muxuu yidhi markii caadku jiray?
Barkhad wuxuu yidhi: "Maya, webigu waa hanjabaad."
Mahad ma dabaashay?
Haa, Mahad wuu dabaashay.
Subaxa dambe caad ma jiray?
Maya, subaxa dambe caad ma jirin.

lessons.title: Cagta Kayse
lessons.summary: Nine-year-old Kayse in Qardho runs fast in the boys' football game; he collides with his friend Sahal, his foot swells, Sahal says sorry and calls his mother, who cools the foot and keeps him home the next day.
lessons.text:
Kayse waa wiil ku nool Qardho. Wuxuu jiraa sagaal sano. Saaxiibkiis Sahal sidoo kale wuxuu jiraa sagaal sano. Labadoodu waxay jecel yihiin ciyaarta kubbadda.

Maalin kasta markay iskuulka ka soo baxaan, waxay tagaan meel u dhow iskuulka. Halkaas sagaal wiil ayaa u yimaada ciyaarta. Kayse aad buu u ordaa. Wiilasha kale waxay yidhaahdaan: "Orod, Kayse, orod!"

Maanta Kayse kubbadda ayuu qaaday oo wuu orday. Sahal sidoo kale wuu orday. Labadoodu way isku dhaceen. Kayse wuxuu ku dhacay dhabarkiisa. Dhabarka iyo cagta xanuun ayuu ka dareemay.

Sahal wuu u yimid. "Raali iga ahow, Kayse! Raali iga ahow!" ayuu yidhi Sahal. "Cagta ma jebisay?"

Kayse wuu istaagay, laakiin si fiican uma socon karin. "Ma aqaan," ayuu yidhi.

Cagtiisu way bararaysay. "Cagtu way bararaysaa," ayuu yidhi Sahal. "Hooyadaa ayaan wacayaa." Sahal wuxuu qaatay telefoonka Kayse oo wuxuu wacay hooyada Kayse.

Hooyadiis si degdeg ah ayay u timid. Waxay eegtay cagta. "Cagtu way barartay, laakiin lafta ma aadan jebin," ayay tidhi. "Cagta waa in la qaboojiyo."

Hooyadiis waxay cagta ku qaboojisay biyo. Kadib waxay tidhi: "Kayse, biyo cab." Kayse biyo ayuu cabbay. Sahal sidoo kale biyo ayuu cabbay. Hooyadiis mar kale ayay cagta qaboojisay, bararkiina wuu yaraaday.

"Hooyo, berri ma tagi karaa ciyaarta?" ayuu weydiiyay Kayse.

"Maya," ayay tidhi hooyadiis. "Berri waa inaad nasato. Berri guriga joog. Toddobaadka dambe mar kale ayaad ordi kartaa."

Sahal wuxuu yidhi: "Raali iga ahow mar kale, Kayse. Berri waan kuu iman doonaa."

Kayse wuu qoslay. "Haa, berri kaalay. Laakiin ha ordin!"

Su'aalo:
Kayse immisa sano ayuu jiraa?
Kayse wuxuu jiraa sagaal sano.
Kayse muxuu ku dhacay?
Kayse wuxuu ku dhacay dhabarkiisa.
Sahal yuu wacay?
Sahal wuxuu wacay hooyada Kayse.
Hooyada Kayse cagta maxay ku qaboojisay?
Hooyada Kayse cagta waxay ku qaboojisay biyo.
Kayse berri ma tagayaa ciyaarta?
Maya, berri Kayse guriga ayuu joogayaa.

lessons.title: Beerta ayeeyo
lessons.summary: In Afgooye, Ilwad helps her grandmother Kaltuun in the garden every afternoon; they need soft ground for new flowers; Ilwad fills a container at the well, hurries and spills water, which makes her grandmother angry, then fills it again, walks carefully and pours the water on the ground.
lessons.text:
Ilwad waa gabadh ku nool Afgooye. Ayeeyadeed Kaltuun waxay leedahay beer yar oo ubax badan leh. Galab kasta Ilwad waxay u tagtaa ayeeyadeed si ay beerta uga caawiso.

Galabtan ayeeyo Kaltuun waxay tidhi: "Ilwad, maanta ubax cusub ayaynu dhigaynaa."

Ayeeyo waxay gacanta ku qabatay dhulka. "Eeg dhulka. Wuu adag yahay. Ubaxu wuxuu u baahan yahay dhul jilicsan."

"Sidee dhulku jilicsan u noqonayaa?" ayay weydiisay Ilwad.

"Biyo ayaa loo baahan yahay. Biyaha waxaynu ka keenaynaa ceelka," ayay tidhi ayeeyo.

Ceelku beerta dhinaceeda ayuu ku yaal. Ilwad waxay qaadatay weel. Weelka ayay ka buuxisay ceelka. Hadda weelku waa buuxaa. Ilwad weelkii buuxa ayay qaadday, si degdeg ah ayayna u socotay. Biyo badan ayay daadisay.

Ayeeyo caro ayay dareentay. "Ilwad, biyaha ha daadin!" ayay tidhi iyadoo caro qabta. "Biyaha ceelku waa muhiim. Si fiican u soco."

"Raali iga ahow, ayeeyo," ayay tidhi Ilwad. Caradii ayeeyo way tagtay.

Ilwad mar kale ceelka ayay tagtay. Weelka mar kale ayay buuxisay. Hadda si fiican ayay u socotay, waxna ma daadin. Weelkii buuxa ayay u keentay ayeeyadeed.

Ayeeyo hadda caro ma qabin. "Hadda biyaha ku shub dhulka," ayay tidhi. Ilwad biyaha ayay ku shubtay dhulka. Dhulkii jilicsan buu noqday.

Kadib ayeeyo iyo Ilwad ubaxii cusub ayay dhigeen dhulka jilicsan.

"Laba toddobaad kadib, ubaxu wuu soo bixi doonaa," ayay tidhi ayeeyo.

Laba toddobaad kadib, galab, Ilwad waxay timid beerta. Ubax cusub ayaa ka soo baxay dhulka. "Ayeeyo, eeg ubaxa!" ayay tidhi Ilwad. Ayeeyo Kaltuun way qososhay.

Su'aalo:
Galab kasta Ilwad yay u tagtaa?
Galab kasta Ilwad waxay u tagtaa ayeeyadeed.
Ubaxu muxuu u baahan yahay?
Ubaxu wuxuu u baahan yahay dhul jilicsan.
Biyaha meeshee ayay ka keeneen?
Biyaha waxay ka keeneen ceelka.
Ilwad maxay samaysay markii ay si degdeg ah u socotay?
Ilwad biyo badan ayay daadisay.
Markii Ilwad biyaha daadisay, ayeeyo maxay dareentay?
Markii Ilwad biyaha daadisay, ayeeyo caro ayay dareentay.
Ilwad biyaha maxay ku shubtay?
Ilwad biyaha waxay ku shubtay dhulka.

lessons.title: Filsan iyo geela
lessons.summary: Filsan from Burco, who loves animals, visits old Idiris in the countryside; she drinks camel milk, rides a young she-camel, and in the afternoon helps him follow the tracks of the camel that left the thorn fence.
lessons.text:
Filsan waa gabadh ku nool Burco. Waxay jeceshahay xayawaanka. Bishan Filsan iyo hooyadeed waxay u safreen miyiga si ay u arkaan Idiris.

Idiris waa oday. Wuxuu yahay adeerka hooyada Filsan. Odaygu wuxuu ku nool yahay aqal yar oo miyiga ku yaal. Aqalka dhinaciisa waxaa ku taal ood weyn. Oodda dhexdeeda waxaa jooga geel badan.

"Habeenkii geela waxaa la dhigaa oodda dhexdeeda," ayuu yidhi odaygu. "Oodda ayaa geela ilaalisa."

Miyiga xayawaan badan ayaa ku nool: geel, xoolo kale iyo eey. Filsan way faraxsanayd. Waxay eegtay xayawaanka oo dhan.

Subaxa odaygu wuxuu maalay hal. Filsan waxay cabtay caanaha hasha. "Waa caano fiican," ayuu yidhi odaygu. Filsan caano badan ayay cabtay.

Kadib odaygu wuxuu yidhi: "Filsan, ma rabtaa inaad geel fuusho?"

"Haa!" ayay tidhi Filsan.

Idiris wuxuu keenay hal yar oo dabo dheer leh. Odaygu wuxuu Filsan ka caawiyay inay fuusho. Filsan hashii way fuushay. Waxay eegtay dabada hasha. Dabadu way dhaqaaqaysay.

Galabtii odaygu wuxuu eegay geela. Hal yar ayaa ka baxday oodda. "Raadkeeda aynu raacno," ayuu yidhi odaygu.

Idiris iyo Filsan waxay raaceen raadka hasha. Raadku wuxuu u socday geed weyn. Filsan waxay aragtay dabada hasha. "Waa halkan!" ayay tidhi. Geedka hoostiisa ayay hashii joogtay.

Waxay hashii ku celiyeen oodda. Habeenkii Filsan aqalka odayga ayay ku jirtay. "Miyiga waan jeclahay. Xayawaanka iyo geela waan jeclahay," ayay tidhi Filsan.

Su'aalo:
Idiris meeshee buu ku nool yahay?
Idiris wuxuu ku nool yahay aqal yar oo miyiga ku yaal.
Habeenkii geela meeshee la dhigaa?
Habeenkii geela waxaa la dhigaa oodda dhexdeeda.
Filsan maxay cabtay?
Filsan waxay cabtay caanaha hasha.
Filsan ma fuushay geel?
Haa, Filsan way fuushay hal yar.
Odayga iyo Filsan maxay raaceen?
Odayga iyo Filsan waxay raaceen raadka hasha yar.

lessons.title: Cashada Burhaan
lessons.summary: Young Burhaan in Berbera, who loves cooking, makes tonight's dinner: he buys camel meat and flour, makes soft bread, lays the table, and the family sits down and shares the food until his little brother is full.
lessons.text:
Burhaan waa nin dhallinyar ah oo ku nool Berbera. Wuxuu jecel yahay inuu cunto sameeyo. Saaka hooyadiis ayaa tidhi: "Burhaan, caawa adiga ayaa cashada samaynaya."

Burhaan suuqa ayuu tagay. Wuxuu iibsaday hilib geel. Wuxuu sidoo kale iibsaday daqiiq.

Galabtii Burhaan cuntada wuu bilaabay. Marka hore hilibka ayuu jaray. Kadib hilibka dabka ayuu saaray. Kadib daqiiqda iyo biyaha ayuu isku daray. Daqiiqda wuxuu ka sameeyay rooti jilicsan.

Walaashiis Leyla ayaa timid. "Burhaan, maxaad samaynaysaa?" ayay weydiisay.

"Waxaan samaynayaa casho. Caawa qoyska oo dhan ayaa cashada cunaya," ayuu yidhi.

Leyla hilibka wax yar ayay ka cuntay. "Hilibku macaan buu leeyahay!" ayay tidhi.

Kadib Burhaan miiska ayuu habeeyay. Leyla ayaa ka caawisay habaynta miiska. Miiska waxay saareen hilibka, rootiga iyo caano macaan.

Habeenkii qoyskii way yimaadeen. "Kaalaya, fadhiista!" ayuu yidhi Burhaan. Hooyadiis, Leyla iyo walaalkiis yar ayaa miiska ku fadhiistay. Burhaan sidoo kale wuu fadhiistay.

"Hilibka aynu qaybsanno," ayuu yidhi Burhaan. Hilibka way qaybsadeen. Rootiga sidoo kale way qaybsadeen. Qof kasta wuxuu helay qayb.

Walaalkiis yar wax badan ayuu cunay. Kadib wuxuu yidhi: "Calooshaydu way buuxdaa!"

"Xanuun ma dareemaysaa?" ayay weydiisay hooyadiis.

"Maya, laakiin calooshaydu way buuxdaa," ayuu yidhi. Dhammaan way qosleen.

Hooyadiis waxay tidhi: "Burhaan, cashadu aad bay u macaan tahay. Caawa cunto wanaagsan ayaad samaysay." Burhaan wuu faraxsanaa.

Su'aalo:
Caawa yaa cashada samaynaya?
Caawa Burhaan ayaa cashada samaynaya.
Burhaan muxuu suuqa ka iibsaday?
Burhaan wuxuu suuqa ka iibsaday hilib iyo daqiiq.
Daqiiqda muxuu ka sameeyay?
Daqiiqda wuxuu ka sameeyay rooti jilicsan.
Qoysku meeshee ayay ku fadhiisteen?
Qoysku waxay ku fadhiisteen miiska.
Walaalka yar muxuu yidhi?
Walaalka yar wuxuu yidhi: "Calooshaydu way buuxdaa."

lessons.title: Hasha caagga ah
lessons.summary: Fardowsa in Muqdisho loves old things; in old Ayuub's shop in Xamar Weyne she finds a small gold camel and a small ivory one at the same price, fetches twenty dollars from the bank, and the honest seller gives back the ten she overpays.
lessons.text:
Fardowsa waxay ku nooshahay Muqdisho. Waxay jeceshahay waxyaabaha hore. Gurigeeda waxaa yaal buugag hore, qalab hore iyo lacag hore.

Galab ayay tagtay dukaan yar oo ku yaal Xamar Weyne. Dukaanka waxaa leh oday la yidhaahdo Ayuub. Ayuub waa nin daacad ah. Dadka magaaladu way ogyihiin inuu daacad yahay.

Dukaanka dhexdiisa, Fardowsa waxay aragtay laba hal oo yaryar. Mid waa dahab, midna waa caag. Caaggu waa wax adag oo cad.

"Labadan hal iibkoodu waa immisa?" ayay weydiisay Fardowsa.

"Labaduba waa isku iib," ayuu yidhi Ayuub. "Mid kasta iibkiisu waa labaatan doolar."

Fardowsa waxay rabtay hasha caagga ah. Waxay eegtay kiis yar oo ay sidato. Kiista waxaa ku jiray toban doolar oo keliya.

"Bangiga ayaan tagayaa," ayay tidhi. Bangigu dukaanka wuu u dhow yahay. Bangiga waxay ka qaadatay labaatan doolar. Lacagta way tirisay: toban, labaatan. Kadib lacagta waxay ku dhigtay kiista. Hadda kiista waxaa ku jiray soddon doolar.

Kadib waxay ku noqotay dukaanka. Waxay Ayuub siisay lacagta kiista oo dhan. Ayuub lacagta wuu tiriyay. "Fardowsa, halkan waxaa ku jira soddon doolar. Hashu waa labaatan doolar," ayuu yidhi. Toban doolar ayuu dib ugu celiyay. Fardowsa way ogayd in Ayuub daacad yahay.

Fardowsa way gadatay hasha caagga ah. Waxay ku dhigtay kiista. "Mar dambe, waxaan gadan doonaa hasha dahabka ah," ayay tidhi.

"Hasha dahabka ah halkan ayay ku jiri doontaa," ayuu yidhi Ayuub. "Iibkeeduna waa labaatan doolar."

Su'aalo:
Fardowsa maxay jeceshahay?
Fardowsa waxay jeceshahay waxyaabaha hore.
Ayuub waa nin sidee ah?
Ayuub waa nin daacad ah.
Labada hal ma isku iib baa?
Haa, labada hal waa isku iib.
Fardowsa lacag meeshee ayay ka qaadatay?
Fardowsa lacag waxay ka qaadatay bangiga.
Fardowsa maxay gadatay?
Fardowsa waxay gadatay hasha caagga ah.

lessons.title: Sheekada Ugaaso
lessons.summary: Ugaaso in Kismaayo dreams of writing books; she enters the school story exhibition with a story about a small island, her teacher Nuurto finds many mistakes and gives useful advice, Ugaaso fixes them, and her story is chosen.
lessons.text:
Ugaaso waa gabadh ku nool Kismaayo. Waxay jirtaa laba iyo toban sano. Riyadeedu waa inay qorto buugag. Markay iskuulka ka soo baxdo, Ugaaso waxay qortaa sheekooyin. Qalin iyo warqad ayay had iyo jeer sidataa.

Maalin, Nuurto oo wax ka dhigta iskuulka ayaa tidhi: "Bisha dambe waxaa jiri doona bandhig sheekooyin. Arday kasta wuu ka qeybgali karaa."

Ugaaso way faraxsanayd. "Waan ka qeybgalayaa!" ayay tidhi.

Kismaayo waxaa u dhow jasiirado yaryar. Mar, Ugaaso iyo adeerkeed waxay tageen jasiirad yar. Ugaaso waxay rabtay inay qorto sheeko ku saabsan jasiiraddaas.

Habeenkaas waxay qalinkeeda ku qortay sheekada jasiiradda. Subaxdii waxay sheekada u keentay Nuurto. Nuurto way akhriday.

"Sheekadu way fiican tahay, laakiin waxaa ku jira khalad badan," ayay tidhi Nuurto. "Eeg erayadan. Waa khalad."

"Sidee baan khaladka u hagaajin karaa?" ayay weydiisay Ugaaso.

"Sheekada mar kale akhri. Eray kasta si fiican u eeg. Kadib khaladka hagaaji," ayay tidhi Nuurto. Talada Nuurto waxay ahayd mid waxtar leh.

Ugaaso guriga ayay ku noqotay. Qalinkeeda ayay qaadatay, khaladkiina way hagaajisay. "Mar kale ayaan tijaabin doonaa," ayay tidhi. Waxay qortay sheekada mar kale. Tijaabadii labaad, khalad ma jirin. Talada waxtarka leh ayaa caawisay.

Toddobaad kadib, Nuurto waxay wargelisay Ugaaso: "Sheekadaada ayaa la doortay. Bandhigga ayaa lagu akhrin doonaa."

Ugaaso ma aamini karin. "Run ma tahay?" ayay weydiisay.

"I aamin, Ugaaso. Waa run," ayay tidhi Nuurto. Hadda Ugaaso way aamintay. Nuurto waxay sidoo kale wargelisay hooyadeed.

Bandhigga, Ugaaso waxay dadka u akhriday sheekadeeda jasiiradda. Dadku aad bay u faraxsanaayeen. "Riyadaydu run bay noqonaysaa," ayay tidhi Ugaaso.

Su'aalo:
Riyada Ugaaso waa maxay?
Riyada Ugaaso waa inay qorto buugag.
Sheekada Ugaaso maxay ku saabsan tahay?
Sheekada Ugaaso waxay ku saabsan tahay jasiirad yar.
Nuurto maxay ku aragtay sheekada?
Nuurto waxay sheekada ku aragtay khalad badan.
Ugaaso khaladka ma hagaajisay?
Haa, Ugaaso khaladka way hagaajisay.
Markii la wargeliyay, Ugaaso ma aamintay?
Marka hore Ugaaso ma aamini karin.

lessons.title: Safarka Taleex
lessons.summary: Cabdikariim in Laascaanood, who loves history, pleads with his parents to visit Taleex; they decide to go, drive the long road, and old Mire tells them about the Dervishes, their spears and flag, and the planes that bombed the houses in 1920.
lessons.text:
Cabdikariim waa wiil ku nool Laascaanood. Wuxuu jecel yahay taariikhda. Maalin ayuu waalidkiis u tibaaxay: "Fadlan, aynu tagno Taleex. Waxaan rabaa inaan arko guriga hore ee Sayid Maxamed."

Waalidkiis way ka fekereen. "Malaha toddobaadka dambe," ayay tidhi hooyadiis. Cabdikariim mar kale ayuu u tibaaxay waalidkiis: "Fadlan!"

Habeenkaas waalidkiis qaraar ayay gaadheen. Qaraarku wuxuu ahaa: "Toddobaadka dambe waynu tagaynaa Taleex." Cabdikariim aad buu u faraxsanaa.

Toddobaadka dambe, subax hore ayay baabuur ku baxeen. Dariiqu wuu dheeraa. Dariiqa waxaa ku yaal dhagax badan iyo geed yar. Saacado badan kadib waxay gaadheen Taleex.

Halkaas waxay ku arkeen oday la yidhaahdo Mire. Mire wuxuu u sheegay taariikhda. "Halkan waxaa ku noolaa Sayid Maxamed iyo raggiisii," ayuu yidhi. "Raggu waxay sidan jireen waran. Waran kasta wuu dheeraa. Calankoodana halkan ayay ka taagi jireen."

Cabdikariim wuxuu arkay guri weyn oo hore oo dhagax ah. Mire wuxuu kaloo tusay meesha calanka laga taagi jiray. "Maxaa gurigan ku dhacay?" ayuu weydiiyay.

"Sannadkii 1920 diyaarado ayaa qarxiyay gurigan," ayuu yidhi Mire. "Diyaaradaha gurigii way qarxiyeen, raggiina halkan way ka tageen."

Guriga hore dhexdiisa iftiin ma jirin. Cabdikariim wuxuu isticmaalay iftiinka telefoonkiisa. Iftiinku wuxuu tusay dhagxaanta hore.

Waalidkiis waxay eegeen wajiga Cabdikariim. Waji faraxsan ayuu lahaa. "Eeg wajiga wiilkeena! Aad buu u faraxsan yahay," ayay tidhi hooyadiis.

Habeenkii, markay guriga ku noqdeen, Cabdikariim wuxuu yidhi: "Malaha mar kale ayaynu tagi doonnaa?"

Waalidkiis way qosleen. "Malaha," ayay yidhaahdeen.

Su'aalo:
Cabdikariim muxuu jecel yahay?
Cabdikariim wuxuu jecel yahay taariikhda.
Cabdikariim yuu u tibaaxay?
Cabdikariim wuxuu u tibaaxay waalidkiis.
Qaraarka waalidkiis muxuu ahaa?
Qaraarku wuxuu ahaa inay toddobaadka dambe tagaan Taleex.
Raggii Sayid Maxamed maxay sidan jireen?
Raggii Sayid Maxamed waxay sidan jireen waran.
Sannadkii 1920 maxaa dhacay?
Sannadkii 1920 diyaarado ayaa qarxiyay guriga hore.

lessons.title: Raadiyaha Xirsi
lessons.summary: Old Xirsi in Burco listens to the radio every night in his comfortable chair; tonight it plays revolutionary songs he and his wife Asli sang when they were young, she asks him to turn the volume down, they laugh at a good joke, and their son calls from London.
lessons.text:
Xirsi waa oday ku nool Burco. Xaaskiisa waxaa la yidhaahdaa Asli. Habeen kasta Xirsi wuxuu ku fadhiistaa kursi weyn oo raaxo leh, wuxuuna maqlaa raadiyaha. "Kursigani waa raaxo," ayuu had iyo jeer yidhaahdaa.

Raadiyaha nin ayaa ka hadla. Marka hore ninku salaan ayuu u diraa dadka raadiyaha maqlaya. Xirsi salaanta wuu jecel yahay.

Habeenkan ninku wuxuu yidhi: "Caawa waxaynu maqli doonnaa heeso kacaan ah oo hore." Raadiyuhu wuxuu bilaabay hees kacaan ah. Xirsi codka raadiyaha wuu kordhiyay.

"Asli, kaalay! Heestan maqal!" ayuu yidhi Xirsi. "Heestan waxaannu maqli jirnay markii aannu dhallinyarada ahayn."

Xaaskiisa Asli way timid. "Haa, heestan waan ogahay. Markii aannu yaraa, heesaha kacaanka ah ayaannu wada qaadi jirnay," ayay tidhi.

Laakiin codku aad buu u weynaa. Asli dhegaheeda ayay gacanta saartay. "Xirsi, fadlan codka gaabi! Dhegahaygu way i xanuunayaan."

Xirsi codkii wuu gaabiyay. "Hadda ma fiican yahay?" ayuu weydiiyay.

"Haa, hadda dhegahaygu way fiican yihiin," ayay tidhi Asli.

Kadib raadiyaha nin kale ayaa kaftan sheegay. Kaftankii wuxuu ahaa mid wacan. Xirsi iyo xaaskiisa aad bay u qosleen. "Kaftankani waa wacan yahay," ayay tidhi Asli.

Markaas telefoonka ayaa dhacay. Wiilkooda Galad ayaa ka soo wacay London. Xirsi ayaa la hadlay. Galad wuxuu yidhi: "Hooyo salaan ii dheh."

Xirsi wuxuu u sheegay Asli: "Galad wuxuu leeyahay: Hooyo salaan ii dheh." Asli way faraxsanayd. "Isagana salaan iiga dheh," ayay tidhi.

Kadib Xirsi wuxuu ku fadhiistay kursigiisa raaxada leh. "Habeen wacan," ayuu yidhi.

Su'aalo:
Xaaska Xirsi magaceed waa maxay?
Xaaska Xirsi waxaa la yidhaahdaa Asli.
Habeen kasta Xirsi muxuu sameeyaa?
Habeen kasta Xirsi wuxuu maqlaa raadiyaha.
Caawa raadiyaha maxaa laga maqlay?
Caawa raadiyaha waxaa laga maqlay heeso kacaan ah.
Asli maxay tidhi markii codku weynaa?
Asli waxay tidhi: "Fadlan codka gaabi."
Kaftanku sidee buu ahaa?
Kaftanku wuxuu ahaa mid wacan.

lessons.title: Sawirrada Safiya
lessons.summary: Safiya in Eyl loves taking photos from the top of a hill; she photographs her ill neighbour Saado reading the Quran and brings her red flowers, and after Saado dies she goes to the condolence visit and gives the photos to Saado's daughter Anab.
lessons.text:
Safiya waa gabadh ku nool Eyl. Waxay jeceshahay sawir qaadashada. Galab kasta waxay fuushaa buur yar oo magaalada u dhow. Dusha buurta ayay ka eegtaa cirka. Galabtii cirku waa cas. Safiya cirka cas ayay sawir ka qaaddaa.

Saado waa hooyo da' weyn oo ku nool guri u dhow guriga Safiya. Saado waa bukaan. Muddo badan ayay bukaan ahayd. Subax kasta Saado waxay akhridaa kitaabka. Kitaabkeedu waa mid weyn oo hore.

Maalin, Safiya waxay sawir ka qaadday Saado oo kitaabka akhrinaysa. Saado way qososhay. "Sawir qaadashada waad ku fiican tahay," ayay tidhi.

Safiya sidoo kale waxay Saado u keentay ubax cas. Ubaxii cas qolka wuu qurxiyay. "Ubaxu qolka wuu qurxiyay," ayay tidhi Saado.

Toddobaad kadib Saado way dhimatay. Safiya iyo hooyadeed waxay tacsi u tageen gabadha Saado, Anab. Dad badan ayaa tacsi u yimid. Haweenku waxay dadka u qaybinayeen cunto. Safiya iyo hooyadeed sidoo kale way caawiyeen qaybinta cuntada.

Kadib Safiya waxay Anab siisay sawirradii. "Kuwan waa sawirrada hooyadaa," ayay tidhi. "Kuwan waxaa ku jira hooyadaa oo kitaabka akhrinaysa."

Anab way faraxsanayd. Kuwii Safiya keentay waxay dhigtay dusha miiska. "Kuwani gurigeena way qurxiyeen," ayay tidhi Anab.

Galabtii Safiya mar kale buurta ayay fuushay. Dusha buurta ayay ka eegtay cirka cas.

Su'aalo:
Safiya maxay jeceshahay?
Safiya waxay jeceshahay sawir qaadashada.
Galab kasta cirku waa sidee?
Galab kasta cirku waa cas.
Subax kasta Saado maxay akhridaa?
Subax kasta Saado waxay akhridaa kitaabka.
Haweenku maxay qaybinayeen?
Haweenku waxay dadka u qaybinayeen cunto.
Anab kuwii Safiya keentay meeshee ayay dhigtay?
Anab waxay dhigtay dusha miiska.
